messages:
mya (People Ops): Heads up — automated intake found multiple submissions for a handful of employees. We need managers to confirm the canonical packet to avoid duplicate entries in calibration. Please read quick rules below and reply with the canonical receipt id or upload a single canonical file. :mag:

ravi (Eng Manager): Uh — we have two receipts for the same IC. One is the form our lead filled, another is an exported doc with extra peer quotes. Which one should I pick?

alana (People Ops): Short version: prefer manager-signed form as canonical. If you have supplemental evidence, attach it as EVID_* and reference the canonical form receipt. Do NOT upload a second full review form unless you intend to change the official rating.

chris (Manager): What if the two forms disagree on the rating (typo on one)? Both have manager initials.

mya (People Ops): If ratings conflict: a) pick the document that has manager signoff and matches what you discussed with your manager/career ladder; b) if both claim signoff and ratings differ, escalate immediately to @alana with both receipts and a one-line reason — we will lock one and record an audit note.

intake-bot: duplicate-detect: 2 submissions found for reviewer_id=U12345 (checksums differ)  receipts: a1b2-33ff, c4d5-77aa  created: 2026-07-28T14:02:11Z, 2026-07-28T14:05:33Z

ravi (Eng Manager): I can confirm receipt c4d5-77aa (the later one) has corrections and the manager confirmation line. Marking canonical. Do I need to rename anything?

mya (People Ops): Thanks @ravi — reply here with the receipt id (you did). We'll mark c4d5-77aa canonical. No rename needed but if you want local clarity you can prefix the file with CANONICAL_ in your archive. We'll also attach an automated audit note: canonical=<receipt>.

ravi (Eng Manager): One more edge: we accidentally submitted both because someone hit submit twice after a slow upload. Can you remove the duplicate from the manager queue?

alana (People Ops): We'll de-duplicate on our side for calibration packets. The older receipt will be moved to an archival folder and linked as "duplicate_of". If you need it restored for any reason, DM and we can revert within 72 hours.

chris (Manager): For transparency, will you surface which fields differed so I can confirm nothing important was lost?

mya (People Ops): Yes — we generate a one-page diff (anonymized) that shows field-level changes (rating, summary length, attachments added). It appears under Review Console > admin > duplicates. We'll share restricted access to managers for their team.

ravi (Eng Manager): Good. Also, for future: any recommended quick workflow to avoid accidental duplicate submissions?

alana (People Ops): Two tips: 1) wait for the intake-bot receipt before re-submitting (receipt usually appears within 10s), 2) for large attachments export to PDF and attach before submitting the form so the upload doesn't timeout and trigger retries. We'll add a tooltip to the form.

mya (People Ops): Final note: if you intentionally submitted a revised form (i.e., rating change), indicate "REVISION" in the top-matter and DM @alana so we can route through the rating-change exception workflow. Otherwise we will treat extras as duplicates. Thanks for the quick confirms. :white_check_mark:
